title: Chapter 121 The Value Of Zerg Currency
content:
Chapter 121 The Value Of Zerg Currency

Wu Qing asked the Insect Queen to make the biological material into the coin he remembered, with images of Zerg puppies and Hydralisks printed on both sides.

According to the size and color of the coin, the amount of stored energy can be freely adjusted. Wu Qing defines the brass-colored and smallest energy coin as an energy coin, which stores a little bit of system energy.

The Zerg energy coin designed by Wu Qing and the Queen of Insects can be said to be the most powerful energy coin in the world. The energy contained in it is pure and without a trace of impurities.

The energy storage capacity of the energy coin is clearly marked and easy to identify. The energy consumption of an energy coin can also be accurately identified by color. This is a groundbreaking design.

If the Zerg energy coins are circulated, they will definitely be very popular.

In many worlds, money is the carrier of luck. Earning wealth and money means earning luck.

The existence of territories in this world in the form of organizations such as chambers of commerce shows that wealth and money are also carriers of luck, and chambers of commerce develop by earning wealth and accumulating luck.

Wu Qing judged that currency in this world played an extremely important role, and he wanted to get involved if conditions allowed.

The development of the system and the Zerg is actually not much different from the personal development of ordinary people. The accumulation of resources and wealth relies on increasing revenue and reducing expenditure.

Multiple sources of income are the best way to quickly accumulate wealth and resist risks.

This is the reason why Wu Qing keeps making plans in this world, especially the elusive luck. There are many ways to obtain it. You don't know at all. Maybe an inadvertent layout will lead to unimaginable luck.

The world is ever-changing, and one day the Zerg may be faced with a situation where they have no battle to fight. At that time, they will need to rely on other ways to obtain resources to continue to support the development of the Zerg.

Wu Qing asked the Insect Queen to create a batch of Zerg energy coins, consume system energy to recharge these energy coins, and send them to Alliance City.

Accompanying him is an army composed of Zerg puppies. Now that a foreign caravan has entered the scope of Mengchong City, Wu Qing wants to strengthen the defense of Mengchong City.

As for the troops in the Zerg territory, as long as there is enough energy, the consumed troops can be replenished at any time, and there is no need to station a large number of troops all the time.

The main force of the Zerg has been assembled and lurking in the cave base, waiting for the arrival of night.

…

The Zerg army marched quickly along the main road leading to Alliance City. Along the way, they encountered many teams from alliance territories. They were all teams of lords rushing to Alliance City to prepare for transactions with caravans.

Meng and the other five lords have already arrived at Alliance Chong City first. Wu Qing is not planning to go there in person this time. He will contact the lords through the host, and the Queen of Insects will control the Zerg to arrange various affairs in Alliance Chong City.

The Zerg army rushed to Alliance City and further strengthened the defense of Alliance City, which made the lords of the alliance feel at ease.

After Wu Qing and other alliance lords who needed to trade with the caravan arrived, they gathered everyone together and took out the Zerg energy coins.

The alliance lords, including the five major lords Meng and others, need to exchange a large amount of energy coins with the caravan every time. Wu Qing, based on the principle of keeping the money from others, first takes out the Zerg energy coins and trades them with the alliance lords.

"What kind of energy coin is this?! The energy is so pure! I've never seen it before!"

Meng held a golden energy coin and looked at it in surprise. He saw the patterns printed on both sides of the energy coin.

"The pattern of the Zerg troops? Is this the Zerg energy coin?!"

Meng looked at the host floating in the air next to him in surprise. Wu Qing was not here, so he could only ask the host if he had questions.

The host's mental power is powerful, and it can interfere with reality through mental power to simulate sounds, and can communicate through language.

When Hu Wei and other lords saw Meng's expression, they all gathered around. Each of them picked up an energy coin and got the energy coin with his own hands. Their behavior was similar to that of Meng. They were all surprised first and then surprised!

"Yes, this is an energy coin made by the Zerg."

"The lord learned that the lords will exchange a large amount of energy coins with the caravan, so he took out these energy coins for everyone to exchange them first."

The Zerg host explained.

"The quality of Zerg energy coins is much better than the energy coins exchanged by caravans! This kind of energy coins can greatly promote the development of our various territories!"

An alliance lord held a Zerg energy coin and said with care.

In the hands of these lords, energy coins are mainly used to improve the strength of individuals or army soldiers. The purer the energy coins, the more obvious the effect, and the faster the strength is improved.

With the Zerg energy coins, the strength of the soldiers in each territory will increase exponentially. This effect is immeasurable.

"Our alliance has its own energy coins. In the future, everyone can redeem them at any time within the alliance. The impact of those caravans on us will be greatly reduced!"

Another lord saw other benefits brought by Zerg energy coins.

"What is the output of this energy coin? Can it support the consumption of the entire alliance?"

Hu Wei asked the Zerg host.

No matter how many benefits the Zerg Energy Coin has, it doesn't mean much if it can't be produced in large quantities, so Hu Wei's question is very critical.

"As long as we have enough energy ore, there will definitely be no problem in ensuring the alliance's supply."

The Zerg host replied.

The true production capacity of the Zerg cannot be disclosed casually. The crime of holding a treasure is the same in that world.

Real energy ores can provide a large amount of energy resources to the system. In Wu Qing's plan, in addition to the luck beads, energy ores and other things he needs can be exchanged for the Zerg as long as they are beneficial to the development of the system and the Zerg. of energy coins.

Zerg Energy Coin will be a popular Zerg currency that will be vigorously promoted in the future.

"This puts us at ease!"

"What is the specific method of exchanging the Zerg energy coins?"

The issue of interests involved must be made clear in advance.

"Based on the energy stones of different qualities in the caravan, our luck can only be exchanged for thirty to one hundred points of energy. Considering the quality of the Zerg's energy coins, their value must be at least five to ten times higher than theirs!"

Wu Qing was not around, so he spoke first to set a tone, lest any alliance lord take advantage of the Zerg and destroy the good atmosphere that the alliance had finally cultivated.

The energy content of the energy coins in this world is exactly equal to the energy of the system. Like luck, this must be specially adjusted by the system according to this world.

"I agree with Lord Fierce!"

Hu Wei stood up to support Meng. He was not just for the internal unity of the alliance, he truly understood the value of this Zerg energy coin.
